_about: Extra content for the offline demo only. Real tips come from the live database at build time.

Volle steekkar.body_en: Already have three crates on your hand truck and still need to bring a few bags? Put them on top of the upper totes. Hook the bag handles onto the fold-out black handles at the top of the hand truck, then fold the handles back in. That keeps the bags in place so they don't fall off.

Geen plek voor lids/ deksels.body_en: Stack two lids and wedge their corners into the top corner of the frame, then put the other lids on top. Works well with a frame that is three high and completely full.

L en R totes.body_en: Need totes from both sides? Check which side you need the most from and open only that side. Take out all the totes you need there, including the ones from the other side: temporarily put the front totes on the ground so you can reach the ones at the back.

commentTranslations.Alleen handig als de totes die ervoor zi: Only handy if the totes in front are empty too. Otherwise it's unnecessary lifting.
